exposure.needed: whether the cluster has existing UpdateRequest (kyverno.io) objects stored as v1beta1 in etcd, and whether status.storedVersions of updaterequests.kyverno.io still lists v1beta1

consequence.statement: Existing UpdateRequest objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten. A storage version migration and an update of status.storedVersions must be done before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, rewrite all updaterequests.kyverno.io objects so they are stored as v2. Then remove v1beta1 from the CRD's status.storedVersions.

assertion.statement: From 1.12.6 to 1.13.0, the storage version of the updaterequests.kyverno.io CRD moves from v1beta1 to v2. Existing UpdateRequest objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten, so a storage version migration and an update of status.storedVersions are needed before a later release removes v1beta1.
